name: Technogym S.p.A.
note: Italian fitness-equipment maker listed on Borsa Italiana's EXM (Euronext Milan). Per its 2025 annual report: TGH S.r.l. holds 33.78% of the share capital (60.47% of voting rights; TGH is 75%-owned by Oiren S.r.l. and 25% by Path S.r.l.); NIF Holding (Italy) S.r.l., with Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund at the head of its control structure, holds 6%; the remaining 52.02% is free float.
